{{Quote|The simple truth is that we are not warriors, Master Yoda. An armed conflict will destroy us. We will negotiate with Count Dooku if we are able.|Roshti|<ref name="The Clone Wars 1">[[The Clone Wars 1|''The Clone Wars'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''Roshti''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] and the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
[[File:SeparatistArrival-Kidnapped.png|thumb|left|250px|Roshti telling Yoda that the Separatists had already arrived.]]
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Roshti was [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]], a colony of peaceful Togruta. Fearing for his colony's safety in during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he nevertheless negotiated with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]. He was contacted by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], who warned the Togrutan against trusting [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], offering to send [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] troops to Kiros. When Dooku arrived with an invasion fleet of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], Roshti again stated his wish for his people to remain neutral in the conflict. Dooku ignored the Governor, insisting that he would provide the Togrutans with a safe haven. In actuality, Roshti and the entire colony were sold to the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrians]] as slaves.<ref name="K">{{TCW|Kidnapped}}</ref>

On Zygerria, Roshti was separated from his fellow colonists and kept in a cell for the upcoming auction. Roshti was found by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] as he searched for the kidnapped Togrutain colonists, but was too weak to tell him where the other Togrutans were being held. Kenobi and [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] attempted to escape with the Governor on a [[Brezak/Legends|brezak]], but the escape was cut short by a well placed shot from a Zygerrian guard, hitting Kenobi and causing him and Roshti to fall off the brezak. Roshti was then brought to the slave auction to be sold, representing the entire Togrutan population. Before his auction could commence, the Queen introduced Obi-Wan. A fight broke out between the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the Zygerrians but Roshti, too weak to fight, could not contribute to the fight. He was captured and sent with Kenobi on the slave ship the [[Delta-T-3/Legends|Delta-T-3]], to the [[Kadavo slave processing facility/Legends|Kadavo slave processing facility]], where the other Togruta were being held.<ref name="SotR">{{TCW|Slaves of the Republic}}</ref>

When Skywalker, [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and Master [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] attacked the facility, he was rescued along with the other Togrutans. Back on Coruscant while talking to Tano, he expressed his concerns for the safety of his people and stated his intention to join the Republic.<ref name="EfK">{{TCW|Escape from Kadavo}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|We had debated ... having Roshti mention that he knows Ahsoka's parents, or knew her parents ... and that that would somehow play out for why she had an instinct to save the people. In the end, we ended up not going with that because ... we don't have something later that goes on to explore that more, and I thought it'd kinda be almost a mean thing to do.|Dave Filoni|<ref name="TFN" />}}
[[File:Gov_of_kiros.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Roshti in ''The Clone Wars'' comic version of the storyline]]
Roshti's first appearance was in the comic [[The Clone Wars 1|''The Clone Wars'' 1]], which was released in 2008.<ref name="The Clone Wars 1" /> The comics were later adapted into a story arc, which was featured in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Season Four">[[The Clone Wars: Season Four|''The Clone Wars'': Season Four]]</ref>

According to [[Dave Filoni]], the script originally had Roshti knowing or having known [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano's]] parents as a means to imply that that's why Ahsoka has an instinct to save people. However, Filoni and his crew ultimately nixed the idea because they didn't want to flesh out Roshti's line and Filoni personally felt that Roshti saying so to Ahsoka sounded like a "mean" thing to do.<ref name="TFN">{{WebCite|url=http://theforce.net/topstory/story/Filoni_On_ForceCast_TCW_Will_Explore_Order_66_143192.asp|text=Filoni On ForceCast: TCW Will Explore Order 66|date=2012-01-21|archivedate=20120122230210}}</ref>
